datasets.title: Switzerland Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 2.8 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 88% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 1 year, 3 months ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 8% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['building'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en building building:levels building:materials addr:full addr:housenumber addr:street addr:city office source name:fr name:de name:it name:rm This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap as volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Data completeness was validated against AI-mapped estimates, and temporal metadata tracks editing history to assess data currency and coverage.
